exposure_factor.note: Indoor factor is an ASSUMPTION (indoor PM2.5 as a share of outdoor). Configurable. Label it in the UI.

inhalation_rate_m3_min.age_group: 6 to <11 years, mean, males and females combined
inhalation_rate_m3_min.source: US EPA Exposure Factors Handbook (2011), Chapter 6, Table 6-2

pm25_categories.source: CPCB National AQI (2014), as tabled in IMD AQI SOP Table 3.1
pm25_categories.note: Bands are defined for 24-hour averages. Applying them to hourly forecast values is an approximation.

all_indoors_rule: If no school hour has PM2.5 at or below this value (i.e. every hour is Very Poor or worse), all outdoor periods become indoor activity.
